title: Travel advisory and safety check for a destination
description: Research current advisory and safety context for a destination, classify the risk level, and route to a Safe, Caution, or Avoid outcome.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: travel-safety-check
  title: "Travel advisory and safety check for a destination"
  description: Research current advisory and safety context for a destination, classify the risk level, and route to a Safe, Caution, or Avoid outcome.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Give the traveler a clear, sourced risk classification for a destination ahead of booking or departure.
  policies: { maxConcurrency: 2, onFailure: stop, requireApprovalFor: [] }
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Destination and travel window
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required: [text]
        properties:
          text: { type: string, description: The destination(s), travel dates, and traveler nationality if relevant. }
        x-ladder-input-mode: text
    - id: advisory-researcher
      kind: agent
      inlineRole: true
      name: Advisory and safety researcher
      role: Researcher on travel advisories and destination safety context.
      prompt: Research the categories of safety and advisory context relevant to this destination (government travel advisories, health notices, local conditions) and describe where to verify each one's current official status rather than stating a specific advisory level as fact. Cross-check across at least two sources when possible. Flag that advisory levels can change and should be reconfirmed close to departure.
      capabilities: { skills: [research, compliance-review], tools: [read, search], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, properties: { advisory_categories: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, sources_to_verify: { type: array, items: { type: string } }, notes: { type: string } } }
    - id: risk-classifier
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Classify overall risk
      role: Independent evaluator who classifies destination risk from the researched context.
      prompt: Based on the researched advisory categories and notes, classify the overall risk as safe, caution, or avoid, and give the reasons behind the classification. Note explicitly that this classification is a snapshot and should be reconfirmed against official sources close to departure.
      capabilities: { skills: [evaluation], tools: [read], permissions: [read-only] }
      outputSchema: { type: object, required: [classification, reasons], properties: { classification: { type: string, enum: [safe, caution, avoid] }, reasons: { type: array, items: { type: string } } } }
      config: { threshold: 0.7 }
    - id: decision
      kind: condition
      name: Risk classification routing
      config: { expression: "risk-classifier.classification", branches: [ { label: Safe, when: safe }, { label: Caution, when: caution }, { label: Avoid, when: avoid } ] }
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Safety classification and reasoning
  edges:
    - { id: e1, from: intake, to: advisory-researcher, kind: data }
    - { id: e2, from: advisory-researcher, to: risk-classifier, kind: data }
    - { id: e3, from: risk-classifier, to: decision, kind: data }
    - { id: e4, from: decision, to: result, kind: control, condition: safe }
    - { id: e5, from: decision, to: result, kind: control, condition: caution }
    - { id: e6, from: decision, to: result, kind: control, condition: avoid }
